title: Case 2: July 2001 Active Monsoon Depression
description: Deep monsoon depression developing over northwest Bay of Bengal and tracking west-northwestward with heavy orographic enhancement along Western Ghats.

frames.caption_strip: Day 1 lead: NWP predicts 41.0 mm/day in Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram & Tripura, but synoptic analogues indicate 32% probability of dry bust (actual: 7.0 mm/day). Effective Lead Time jumps from Day 1.0 to Day 3.7 ahead of raw NWP spread (1.6 mm). Forecaster confidence downgraded to LOW.
